SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS charter_funded_schools_count
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE sat.avgscrmath > 560
  AND s.fundingtype = 'Directly Funded';

SELECT s."phone"
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON s."cdscode" = sat."cds"
WHERE sat."numtsttakr" > 0
ORDER BY (sat."numge1500"::NUMERIC / sat."numtsttakr") DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s."sname", s."avgscrwrite", sc."charternum"
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s."cds" = sc."cdscode"
WHERE s."avgscrwrite" > 499
  AND sc."charternum" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s."avgscrwrite" DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.cdscode = s.cds
ORDER BY s.avgscrread DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT adm_name, district
FROM (
    SELECT adm_name, district, COUNT(*) AS cnt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST, adm_name ASC NULLS FIRST) AS rn
    FROM (
        SELECT "admfname1" AS adm_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname1" <> ''
        UNION ALL
        SELECT "admfname2" AS adm_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname2" <> ''
        UNION ALL
        SELECT "admfname3" AS adm_name, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname3" <> ''
    ) AS names
    GROUP BY adm_name, district
) AS ranked
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY cnt DESC NULLS LAST, adm_name ASC NULLS FIRST;
SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE s.school ILIKE '%Youth Authority School%' AND s.mailstreet ILIKE '%PO Box 1040%';

SELECT s."ncesschool", f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."cdscode" = s."cdscode"
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(ss."numtsttakr") AS avg_test_takers
FROM satscores ss
JOIN schools s ON ss."cds" = s."cdscode"
WHERE s."county" ILIKE '%Fresno%'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s."opendate"::date) = 1980;

SELECT s."gsoffered"
FROM schools s
WHERE s."longitude" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(s."longitude") DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.school, s.street
FROM satscores AS ss
JOIN schools AS s ON ss.cds = s.cdscode
ORDER BY ss.avgscrmath DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT s."phone", s."ext"
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON sat."cds" = s."cdscode"
WHERE sat."avgscrwrite" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat."avgscrwrite" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332;

SELECT s."avgscrmath", sc."county"
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s."cds" = sc."cdscode"
ORDER BY (s."avgscrmath" + s."avgscrread" + s."avgscrwrite") ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.street, s.city, s.zip, s.state
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.cdscode = sc.cds
WHERE sc.numtsttakr > 0
ORDER BY (sc.numge1500::NUMERIC / sc.numtsttakr) ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."school", ss."avgscrwrite", s."phone"
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s."cdscode" = ss."cds"
WHERE (s."opendate" IS NOT NULL AND s."opendate"::date > DATE '1991-12-31')
   OR (s."closeddate" IS NOT NULL AND s."closeddate"::date < DATE '2000-01-01');

SELECT
  (f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0)) AS free_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.admfname1 ILIKE '%Kacey%'
  AND s.admlname1 ILIKE '%Gibson%';

SELECT s.county, s.school, s.closeddate
FROM schools s
WHERE s.statustype = 'Closed'
AND s.county = (
    SELECT s2.county
    FROM schools s2
    WHERE s2.statustype = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY s2.county
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY s.closeddate ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT s."phone"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
  AND s."fundingtype" = 'Directly Funded'
  AND s."opendate" > TO_DATE('2000/1/1', 'YYYY/MM/DD');

SELECT s."District Code", f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)"
FROM schools sch
JOIN frpm f ON sch.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE sch.admfname1 ILIKE '%Alusine%';

SELECT s.city, f."Low Grade", s.school
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.state = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.latitude ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.admemail1
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s."school", s."doctype"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE s."fundingtype" = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (
    SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
    FROM schools s2
    JOIN frpm f2 ON s2."cdscode" = f2."cdscode"
    WHERE s2."fundingtype" = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT s.admfname1, s.admlname1
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.cdscode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.numge1500 = (SELECT MAX(numge1500) FROM satscores)
ORDER BY s.admfname1 ASC NULLS FIRST, s.admlname1 ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS non_chartered_schools_count
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.charter = 0
  AND s.county = 'Los Angeles'
  AND (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0)) < 0.18;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."city") AS city_count, s."city", COUNT(DISTINCT s."cdscode") AS school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE s."magnet" = 1
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
  AND f."Low Grade" = 'K'
  AND f."High Grade" = '8'
GROUP BY s."city"
ORDER BY school_count DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT c."artist"
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."side" IS NULL
ORDER BY c."convertedmanacost" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."id") 
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."artist" ILIKE '%John Avon%'
  AND c."cardkingdomfoilid" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT c."name"
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE fd."language" = 'Japanese';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards c
WHERE c.originaltype = 'Summon - Angel'
  AND c.subtypes IS NOT NULL
  AND c.subtypes <> 'Angel';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count, "c"."id" AS card_id
FROM "cards" AS "c"
WHERE "c"."bordercolor" = 'black'
GROUP BY "c"."id";

SELECT DISTINCT c."name"
FROM "cards" c
WHERE (c."power" IS NULL OR c."power" = '*')
  AND c."promotypes" ILIKE '%arenaleague%'
ORDER BY c."name" ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT fd."language", fd."flavortext", c."type"
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."watermark" = 'colorpie';
SELECT "keywords" FROM "cards" WHERE "name" = 'Angel of Mercy';
SELECT "convertedmanacost" FROM "cards" WHERE "name" = 'Ancestor''s Chosen';

SELECT s."id"
FROM "sets" s
ORDER BY s."basesetsize" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count"
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."artist" = 'Aaron Miller'
  AND c."cardkingdomfoilid" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."cardkingdomid" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT c."originalreleasedate", l."format"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l ON c."uuid" = l."uuid"
WHERE c."rarity" = 'mythic'
  AND l."status" = 'legal'
  AND c."originalreleasedate" = (
    SELECT MIN(c2."originalreleasedate")
    FROM "cards" c2
    WHERE c2."rarity" = 'mythic'
      AND c2."originalreleasedate" IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY l."format" ASC NULLS LAST;

SELECT st."translation"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "set_translations" st ON st."setcode" = c."setcode"
WHERE c."name" = 'Tendo Ice Bridge'
  AND st."language" = 'French';

SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN s."type" = 'expansion' THEN 1 END)::NUMERIC
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 AS percentage
FROM set_translations st
JOIN sets s ON s."code" = st."setcode"
WHERE st."language" = 'Japanese';

SELECT l."status"
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c."uuid" = l."uuid"
WHERE c."types" = 'Artifact'
  AND c."side" IS NULL
  AND l."format" = 'vintage';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."id") AS card_count
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l ON c."uuid" = l."uuid"
JOIN "rulings" r ON c."uuid" = r."uuid"
WHERE l."format" = 'premodern'
  AND r."text" = 'This is a triggered mana ability.'
  AND c."side" IS NULL;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."isstoryspotlight" = 1 AND c."istextless" = 0)
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::NUMERIC,
    2
  ) AS percentage
FROM cards c;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."code") FROM "sets" s JOIN "set_translations" st ON s."code" = st."setcode" WHERE st."language" = 'Japanese' AND (s."mtgocode" IS NULL OR s."mtgocode" = '');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c."id") AS count
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l ON c."uuid" = l."uuid"
WHERE c."rarity" = 'rare'
  AND c."types" LIKE '%Enchantment%'
  AND c."name" = 'Abundance'
  AND l."status" = 'Legal';

SELECT c.id, r.text
FROM cards c
JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.artist ILIKE '%Stephen%Daniele%'
  AND c.hascontentwarning = 1
ORDER BY c.id ASC NULLS FIRST, r.text ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT DISTINCT s."name", s."mtgocode"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE c."name" = 'Angel of Mercy'
  AND s."mtgocode" IS NOT NULL;

SELECT s."id"
FROM "sets" s
WHERE s."type" = 'commander'
ORDER BY s."totalsetsize" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c."name", r."text", CASE WHEN c."hascontentwarning" = 1 THEN 'has missing or degraded properties' ELSE 'does not have missing or degraded properties' END AS "property_status"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "rulings" r ON c."uuid" = r."uuid"
WHERE c."artist" ILIKE '%Jim Pavelec%';

SELECT c."name", l."format"
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
JOIN legalities l ON c."uuid" = l."uuid"
WHERE s."name" = 'Hour of Devastation'
  AND l."status" = 'Legal';

SELECT
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN c."hascontentwarning" = 0 THEN 1 END)::NUMERIC
   / NULLIF(COUNT(c."id"), 0)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "legalities" l ON c."uuid" = l."uuid"
WHERE l."format" = 'commander'
  AND l."status" = 'legal';

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN c."isnonfoilonly" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "foreign_data" fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE fd."language" = 'Japanese';

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c."language" = 'French')::NUMERIC
  / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100 AS percentage
FROM "cards" c
WHERE c."power" IS NULL OR c."power" = '*';

SELECT DISTINCT s."id"
FROM "sets" s
JOIN "cards" c ON c."setcode" = s."code"
JOIN "foreign_data" fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE s."isforeignonly" = 1
  AND s."isfoilonly" = 1
  AND fd."language" = 'Japanese';

SELECT
  (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fd."language" = 'French')::NUMERIC
   / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::NUMERIC) * 100 AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd."uuid" = c."uuid"
WHERE c."isstoryspotlight" = 1;

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN c."cardkingdomfoilid" IS NOT NULL AND c."cardkingdomid" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC
   / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE s."name" = 'Coldsnap';

SELECT DISTINCT c."artist"
FROM "cards" c
JOIN "sets" s ON c."setcode" = s."code"
WHERE s."name" = 'Coldsnap'
  AND c."artist" IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller', 'Chippy');
